description: Platform-neutral transitions for interactive, cached, and plan-aware New Stats behavior introduced through WordPress Android 27.6

invariants: the persisted semantic choice remains visitors across restoration
chart header and series represent the same selected metric
switching metrics does not reload data already present in the period response

androidTests: WordPress/src/test/java/org/wordpress/android/ui/newstats/viewsstats/ViewsStatsViewModelTest.kt#when a metric is selected, then the chart re-plots that metric without a new fetch
WordPress/src/test/java/org/wordpress/android/ui/newstats/viewsstats/ViewsStatsViewModelTest.kt#when a metric is selected, then the choice is persisted to the site configuration
evidence.baseSemanticGap: Android 27.1 has no selectable StatsMetric state or persisted metric preference.

invariants: the hourly views fallback never overwrites the user's visitors preference
returning to a multi-day period restores the compatible preference
the bottom row and chart retain one coherent period

androidTests: WordPress/src/test/java/org/wordpress/android/ui/newstats/viewsstats/ViewsStatsViewModelTest.kt#given a single-day period with a persisted non-views metric, then views is charted instead
WordPress/src/test/java/org/wordpress/android/ui/newstats/viewsstats/ViewsStatsViewModelTest.kt#given a single-day fallback, when moving back to a multi-day period, then the pick is charted again
evidence.baseSemanticGap: Android 27.1 has no persisted alternate metric, hourly fallback, or compatible-period restoration behavior.

invariants: an explicit unsupported hourly metric receives an unavailable answer instead of appearing inert
the independent bottom-stats row remains usable
the explicit choice is retained for a compatible period

androidTests: WordPress/src/test/java/org/wordpress/android/ui/newstats/viewsstats/ViewsStatsViewModelTest.kt#when a non-views metric is selected on a single-day period, then the chart is unavailable
WordPress/src/test/java/org/wordpress/android/ui/newstats/viewsstats/ViewsStatsViewModelTest.kt#when a single-day chart fetch fails, then the bottom row still loads from its dedicated call
evidence.baseSemanticGap: Android 27.1 has no alternate metric selection or distinct unavailable chart state.

invariants: soft selection freezes the Views chart on its committed period
header, bottom row, highlight, top range, and other cards refer to the same selected bucket
a bar tap reuses loaded per-bucket data

androidTests: WordPress/src/test/java/org/wordpress/android/ui/newstats/viewsstats/ViewsStatsViewModelTest.kt#when a daily bar is tapped, then it soft-selects without changing the committed period
WordPress/src/test/java/org/wordpress/android/ui/newstats/viewsstats/ViewsStatsViewModelTest.kt#when a bar is soft-selected, then the bottom row reflects that bar
WordPress/src/test/java/org/wordpress/android/ui/newstats/viewsstats/ViewsStatsViewModelTest.kt#when a bar is tapped, then no new fetch is triggered
evidence.baseSemanticGap: Android 27.1 commits a bar tap directly to another period and has no soft selection or split committed/effective period propagation.

invariants: the given soft selection is established through the real bar-tap path
committing clears the transient selection before the destination finishes loading
every visible stats surface receives the committed day

androidTests: WordPress/src/test/java/org/wordpress/android/ui/newstats/viewsstats/ViewsStatsViewModelTest.kt#when the arrow is tapped on a daily selection, then the whole screen drills into that day
evidence.baseSemanticGap: Android 27.1 has no soft-selected bar or separate drill-down commit action.

invariants: future placeholders occupy chart slots but cannot be selected
future placeholders are excluded from the elapsed-bucket average
the chart and all other cards remain on the committed period

androidTests: WordPress/src/test/java/org/wordpress/android/ui/newstats/viewsstats/ViewsStatsViewModelTest.kt#given a period that hasn't finished, then the average only counts the buckets that elapsed
WordPress/src/test/java/org/wordpress/android/ui/newstats/viewsstats/ViewsStatsViewModelTest.kt#when a bucket that hasn't happened yet is tapped, then nothing is selected
evidence.baseSemanticGap: Android 27.1 truncates current-period charting and has no final upcoming-placeholder eligibility model.

invariants: the persisted configuration is read through the production repository after recreation
a paged rolling window remains rolling even when its concrete dates form a calendar month
forward navigation cannot pass the present edge

androidTests: WordPress/src/test/java/org/wordpress/android/ui/newstats/viewsstats/ViewsStatsViewModelTest.kt#given a picked preset, when paging saves the range, then the pick is persisted as the origin
WordPress/src/test/java/org/wordpress/android/ui/newstats/viewsstats/ViewsStatsViewModelTest.kt#given a persisted origin, when restoring, then paging resolves against the picked preset
evidence.baseSemanticGap: Android 27.1 does not persist period origin and cannot preserve rolling-versus-calendar navigation semantics across restoration.

invariants: the failed-revalidation precondition is established through the real screen-entry and refresh path
request identity includes surface, site, current day, period, and variant
only a complete successful retry replaces the cached value and marks it revalidated

androidTests: WordPress/src/test/java/org/wordpress/android/ui/newstats/NewStatsViewModelTest.kt#when the screen is entered, then cached stats are kept but marked for one refresh
WordPress/src/test/java/org/wordpress/android/ui/newstats/repository/StatsResultCacheTest.kt#given markAllStale, then the value is still served but needs revalidation
WordPress/src/test/java/org/wordpress/android/ui/newstats/repository/StatsRepositoryCacheTest.kt#given a stale period, when the previous window fails, then the cached comparison is served
WordPress/src/test/java/org/wordpress/android/ui/newstats/clicks/ClicksViewModelCacheTest.kt#given revalidation fails, then the cached content stays on screen
evidence.testEvidenceGap: Cache failure preservation is directly tested on repository and Clicks surfaces; the Views chart path is supported by revalidateIfNeeded(applyErrors=false) but lacks an equivalent dedicated failure test.
evidence.baseSemanticGap: Android 27.1 has no shared period-result cache or stale-entry background revalidation, so it cannot render cached content immediately, preserve it across failed revalidation, and replace it on retry.

invariants: cache invalidation happens synchronously before visible cards dispatch refreshes
a result that started before invalidation cannot repopulate refreshed cached state
the refresh indicator stops even when competing work completes later

androidTests: WordPress/src/test/java/org/wordpress/android/ui/newstats/repository/StatsResultCacheTest.kt#given a fetch that started before clear, when it is stored, then it is dropped
WordPress/src/test/java/org/wordpress/android/ui/newstats/repository/StatsRepositoryCacheTest.kt#given the cache is emptied mid-fetch, when the result lands, then it is not stored
WordPress/src/test/java/org/wordpress/android/ui/newstats/viewsstats/ViewsStatsViewModelTest.kt#when refresh is called, then isRefreshing becomes true then false
evidence.baseSemanticGap: Android 27.1 has no refresh invalidation boundary that rejects results started before the refresh, so an older completion can repopulate stale cached state.

invariants: unauthorized is plan-gated only when the endpoint is gate-eligible and the user already has view-stats capability
plan-gated and auth-error flags are mutually exclusive
loading the gated surface does not discard the already loaded unrestricted surface

androidTests: WordPress/src/test/java/org/wordpress/android/ui/newstats/datasource/StatsApiErrorTest.kt#given a plan gate body and a user who can view stats, when isStatsGatedByPlan, then true
WordPress/src/test/java/org/wordpress/android/ui/newstats/datasource/StatsApiErrorTest.kt#given a user who cannot view stats, when isStatsGatedByPlan, then false is returned
WordPress/src/test/java/org/wordpress/android/ui/newstats/locations/LocationsViewModelTest.kt#when regions are plan gated, then isPlanGated is true
WordPress/src/test/java/org/wordpress/android/ui/newstats/locations/LocationsViewModelTest.kt#when switching to regions, then regions are fetched
evidence.baseSemanticGap: Android 27.1 already has region switching and per-location state, but the same unauthorized response is only a generic/auth error with retry; it cannot render the final plan-gated Explore Plans state without ordinary retry.
